##### Project general facts

NOAH is a distinctive eco-luxury resort residence by Anta Group, a developer led by a visionary founder who recognised the island’s extraordinary potential. Its collection of exclusive tent villas follows the fastest-growing format in global ultra-luxury hospitality, a concept shared by the world’s most celebrated resort brands. Next-generation eco-architecture, a zero-footprint modular approach, and lightweight structures designed for tropical living preserve the pristine landscape and ancient trees. Villas are offered on a long-term leasehold with an extension option, within an estate that combines a private beach, panoramic ocean views, and ancient jungle.

Residents enjoy an active lifestyle at the sports centre, where mini golf on a picturesque cliff, outdoor fitness areas, functional training spaces, and hiking trails blend into the natural landscape. An open-air cliffside restaurant and an infinity pool on the cliff edge create unforgettable settings for dining, sunset gatherings, and complete privacy. A secluded private beach with gently rolling waves is perfect for morning meditation and moonlit evening ceremonies, while the spa and wellness centre offers an open-air plunge pool, several treatment rooms, a sauna, and a relaxation bath. A tranquil gathering area set in lush greenery, a welcoming reception, and a helipad complete this thoughtfully designed resort ecosystem.

Interiors combine natural stone, glass, warm wood, and eco-friendly bamboo to create a contemporary yet welcoming atmosphere worthy of a premium resort. Certified teak, panoramic aluminium glazing, and breathable outdoor fabrics fill every villa with light and immerse residents in the surrounding tropical beauty. Each villa offers a generous kitchen and living area, a private bedroom space, a refined bathroom, an open terrace, and a signature tropical bath for spa-style relaxation, while selected villas add a fire pit or a private lounge area. Designer furniture, modern plumbing, and wear-resistant fittings are included, so every villa welcomes guests in elegant comfort.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Sumba is among the last untouched corners of Indonesia, where pristine nature and centuries-old traditions live in perfect harmony. Rolling hills covered with golden savannas meet a coastline lined with unspoiled beaches and turquoise water. Ancient jungle, dramatic cliffs, and breathtaking ocean sunsets and sunrises create an atmosphere of profound peace. The island is untouched by haste, and a sense of tranquility can be felt everywhere.

Regular flights from Bali and Kupang connect the island to its airports, making arrival smooth and effortless. A new modern road leads guests through savannas and traditional villages, turning the journey into a scenic experience. Spectacular natural wonders are within reach for memorable excursions, including the multi-tiered Lapopu Waterfall, the wide cascades of Tanggedu Waterfall, and the iconic Mandorak Beach. Photogenic Ratenggaro Village, mangrove-fringed Walakiri Beach, and the crystal-clear Waikuri Lagoon invite further exploration of the island’s cultural and natural heritage.

This rare destination is only beginning to open to the world, offering a remarkable opportunity to be part of its story. Tourism interest is growing steadily as travellers seek authentic, uncrowded places with exceptional natural beauty. Strong demand for premium eco-resort accommodation and rising property values make the island an increasingly attractive choice for investors. With so few comparable destinations left, the location delivers lasting lifestyle appeal and compelling long-term growth potential.
